body_markdown:
When a cyberthreat hits or data goes missing, the question is simple: can you recover? Our customers have given their answer. Cove has been named a Champion and the number one overall product in the Infotech 2026 Enterprise Backup Data Quadrant.


## What the report found


The report evaluates and ranks products based on feedback from IT and business professionals. A product’s placement shows both its ranking relative to other products and its category. In the Enterprise Backup Data Quadrant, Cove ranked first overall with a 9/10 composite score and a 95% likelihood-to-recommend score.


Cove also led the category in two areas that matter when you are choosing software:


**Business Value Created (91%).** Software should create value for employees, customers, and partners, and deliver enough of it to justify the cost. This measure shows how satisfied customers are with the business value they get from a product.


**Product Strategy and Rate of Improvement (88%).** Buying software is a significant commitment, so you need to know your vendor is serious about constant improvement and a deliberate strategic direction. This measure shows which vendors keep up with emerging needs and trends.


Together, these results show that customers see value in Cove today and confidence in where it is headed.


**What sets Cove apart**


Cove is a cloud-native data protection solution that keeps servers, workstations, and SaaS data protected and recoverable from one console. It is built for MSPs and IT teams who need robust protection without added overhead.


- **Smaller, more frequent backups.** Our proprietary TrueDelta™ technology moves up to 60x less data than competitors
- **Protection from threat actors.** All backups are immutable, isolated, and encrypted.
- **Reliable recovery.** Disaster recovery capabilities help organizations get back up quickly after an outage, cyberattack, or data loss.


That approach is earning trust at scale. Cove now protects more than 4 million Microsoft 365 users and 200,000 businesses worldwide.


## Built on customer trust


As Chris Groot, General Manager of Cove Data Protection, put it: “What makes this recognition particularly meaningful is that it stems from our customers.”


At N-able, we will continue to focus on making it simpler to protect the data you rely on, so both you and your customers can be confident it’s available when you need it most.


[Download the report](https://www.n-able.com/resources/infotech-2026-enterprise-backup-data-quadrant) for the complete rankings and vendor comparison behind this recognition.
